ability.name: A Wastrel and a Vagabond
ability.effect:
While a friendly **Deadwalker Zombies** or **Deathrattle Skeletons** unit is wholly within 12" of this unit:
• Add 2 to run rolls for that unit.
• Add 3" to the distance that unit can move when it piles in.

ability.name: Frightening Vitality
ability.effect: Each time an ability would heal exactly 1 or 2 of this unit’s damage points, heal 3 damage points instead.

ability.name: Immortal Ego
ability.effect: Each phase, you can re-roll 1 hit roll, 1 wound roll and 1 save roll for this unit.
